{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nimbus program''' was a training program that was used to bring enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Nationalist Army|Jabiim armed forces]] or sometimes highly skilled [[Jabiimi Loyalists|Loyalist]] defectors into the ranks of [[Nimbus commando]]s. The indoctrination was grueling, but successful initiates were welcomed as senior enlisted and received the rank of [[Nimbus Trooper]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
